title: Customer Change Orders on Entry & Patio Door Contracts: Questions and Answers
content:
A customer change order adds options or units to an Entry & Patio Door Contract.

## The rule

- A door change order can be written only while the contract status is signed or measured. Once the order is released, the door is in production and no change order is accepted.
- Each line is priced at the series price per unit for the option times the units affected; an added unit is priced at the series base price per unit, so an added-unit line is the series base price per unit times the units added, rounded to the cent.
- A sidelite, transom or storm door can be ordered only in a series where it is available, and a multipoint lock is never charged where it is standard.
- All lines written on the same date form one change order.
- A contract may carry no more customer change orders than the series maximum; a request beyond it is refused.
- The customer change orders of a contract are counted, up to and including the change order being handled, as the number of distinct dates on which customer change order lines were written (the automatic custom-size surcharge line is not a customer change order). Those up to the series free count carry no fee, and each later change order carries the series change-order fee once, on the date it is written.
- Adding units may not take the contract above the series maximum unit count.

## Questions the rule answers

**Can a change order be written on a contract in status ordered?**
No. A change order can be written only in status signed or measured; once the order is released no change order is accepted.

**Three option lines are written on one day. How many change orders is that?**
One. All lines written on the same date form one change order, and any change-order fee is charged once for it.

**What is a decorative glass line for two units on a Ridgeline Portal 520 Smooth Fiberglass Entry Door contract? (hypothetical)**
The Portal 520 decorative glass price of $465.00 per unit times 2 units, that is $930.00.

**Can a sidelite be added to a Ridgeline Glide 720 Vinyl Sliding Patio Door?**
No. Sidelites are not available in the Glide 720 series, so it cannot be ordered there.

**Is a multipoint lock charged on a Ridgeline Hinge 960 Wood-Clad French Patio Door?**
No. A multipoint lock is standard in that series and is never charged.

**A Ridgeline Glide 840 Fiberglass Sliding Patio Door contract already carries 4 units. Can a unit be added? (hypothetical)**
No. The Glide 840 maximum is 4 units, and adding units may not take the contract above it.

**When does the change-order fee start? (hypothetical, Ridgeline Portal 640 Woodgrain Fiberglass Entry Door: 2 free, $85.00 fee, maximum 5)**

| Customer change order on the contract | Fee |
|---|---|
| 1st | None |
| 2nd | None |
| 3rd | $85.00 on the date it is written |
| 4th | $85.00 on the date it is written |
| 5th | $85.00 on the date it is written |
| 6th requested | Refused: above the series maximum of 5 |
